method_name: vep-stim (Wang et al. 2025 VBT for stimulation): Stan inversion of a 2D Epileptor network (vep_mcmc / vep_mm_mcmc) + TVB spatial Epileptor forward simulator with stimulation (SpatEpiStim)

primary_source.citation: Wang et al. 2025, Nature Computational Science, Virtual brain twins for stimulation in epilepsy
primary_source.verification: repo URL/commit verified via installed package metadata (direct_url.json commit_id = 5367ef4...) and the local copy; paper not opened in this task

inversion (vep_mcmc.stan data block): Obs [nt x ns] data features (log-transformed inside the model: xs = log(Obs), so Obs must be positive)
eig [nn x nn] matrix shaping the x0 and z_init priors
inversion (vep_mm_mcmc.stan, joint SEEG+: Obs1 [nt x ns1], Obs2 [nt x ns2]
feature extraction (vep_prepare_sim.comp: log power with fixed 100-sample moving window
2-SD outlier clamping before and after log power
forward simulation: TVB connectivity/surface (162 VEP regions; neural-field surface variant)
stimulus spatial weights per node (StimuliSurface_new.weight) and temporal equation (e.g. TVB PulseTrain)
for TI: precomputed spatiotemporal pattern (TI_SpatioTemporalPattern) from EMF maps (compute_TI_envelope)

model_details.inversion_dynamics: 2D Epileptor, explicit Euler, dt=0.1, tau0=15, I1=3.1, fixed x_init=-1.98; dx = 1 - x^3 - 2x^2 - z + I1; dz = (1/tau0)(4(x - x0) - z - K*sum_j SC_ij (x_j - x_i))
model_details.observation_model: log(Obs)[t,s] ~ Normal(amp * (gain x)[s,t] + u[s], eps), i.i.d. across time and sensors (no autocorrelation term)
model_details.priors: x0 = -3.0 + 0.30*eig*x0_star, x0_star~N(0,1); z_init = 4.1 + 0.1*eig*z_init_star, z_init_star~N(0,1); K = 1 + K_star, K_star>-1, ~N(0,1); amp = 0.005 + 0.01*amp_star, amp_star>=0, ~N(0,1); u = 2 + u_star per sensor, ~N(0,1); eps = exp(0.33*log_eps_sq - 3), log_eps_sq~N(0,10)
model_details.sampling_procedure: CmdStan: 50 LBFGS optimize runs (iter 20000, tol_param 1e-10) -> n_init=8 init files -> 2 NUTS chains per init, num_warmup=500, num_samples=500, adapt delta=0.99, seed 12345; model comparison via R loo stacking / pseudo-BMA weights
model_details.forward_model_SpatEpiStim: 7 state variables (u1,u2,s,q1,q2,g,m): 6D Epileptor with local (neural-field) coupling plus accumulation variable m. Stimulus enters u1 as +400*Istim; dm = (1/tau3)(-m + 1000*|Istim|), tau3=2857; when m > threshold (1.8) the Heaviside term H=1 enters ds as 4*(u1 - x0 - H), i.e. raises effective excitability. Defaults x0=-1.6, Iext=3.1, Iext2=0.45, tau0=2857, tau2=10, gamma=0.01. Variables of interest default ['q1 - u1','s']. NB this is not the 2D model used in the inversion (model mismatch between generator and inverter).
model_details.other_forward_components: utils_simulate: SpatEpi (6-variable, no stimulus), Heaviside coupling, LaplaceKernel local connectivity, CorticalSurface_new vertex areas; mln_Cal_area_stimulated: activated tissue area/distance (supp. fig. A9)
model_details.stimulus_models: TVB tvb-library 2.10.0 equations.PulseTrain is available (default T=42, tau=13, amp=1, onset=30; equation where((var>onset)&(((var-onset)%T)<tau), amp, 0)). Package StimuliSurface_new takes a per-node weight array as the spatial pattern (gain-weighted stimulation when weights come from a contact's gain/field); the actual weight source and PulseTrain parameters used by the authors are set in reserved Sim_* notebooks and were NOT verified. TI: compute_TI_envelope.ipynb builds E1(t)=E1*sin(2*pi*1000 t) and E2(t)=E2*sin(2*pi*1005 t) at 10500 Hz for 1 s on the fsaverage5 normal-field maps and takes the Hilbert amplitude envelope of E1+E2 (5 Hz beat).

implementation_versions.stan_models: vep_mcmc.stan, vep_mm_mcmc.stan; shipped C++ generated by Stan 2.21.0; shipped binaries vep_mcmc / vep_mm_mcmc are Linux ELF x86-64 (not runnable on this Windows host)
implementation_versions.authors_stated_deps: README: Stan v2.21.0, FreeSurfer 6, MRtrix 0.3.16, SimNIBS 4.0, Brainstorm3, FSL 5.0.11, GARDEL 1.0, TVB

supported_outputs: posterior samples of x0 per region (EZ estimation), K, amp, u, eps, z_init
posterior predictive x_ppc, log_lik (per element) and log_lik_sum (per time point) for model comparison
simulated SEEG/EEG/source time series under SEEG-contact or TI stimulation (TVB monitors)
activated tissue area / distance under stimulation
validation_setting: Authors' setting (per README): two virtual patients with simulated stimulation-induced seizures, SEEG and TI stimulation, SEEG and EEG monitors. In this system: study-001 attempted the inversion (reported failures; details in study-001 records, not read here). Not validated in study-002 yet.

limitations.defect: Likelihood loop skips the wrong elements
limitations.detail: for(i in (10*ns+1):(nt*ns)) over xs = to_vector(log(Obs)); Stan to_vector is column-major for a [nt x ns] matrix, so the skipped first 10*ns elements are the first 10*ns/nt channels' entire time series, not the first 10 time points. Number of channels dropped = 10*ns/nt (about 10 only if nt ~ ns; e.g. ~3.3 channels for ns=163, nt=500). Study-001 reported 'first ~10 SEEG channels'.

limitations.defect: Filter sampling rate hard-coded to 250 Hz
limitations.detail: examples/stimulation_plot_time_series_P1_TI.ipynb applies signal.butter(4, 2 Hz, 'hp', fs=250) to P1 data whose steps are 10 ms (100 Hz). The P2 EEG plot notebook uses fs=10. Package functions (bfilt/compute_slp_sim) take sfreq as an argument (not hard-coded). Hard-coding in reserved Sim_* notebooks reported by study-001 is not re-verified. Data rates: P1 100 Hz, P2 125 Hz (SEEG-stim) / 100 Hz (TI).

limitations.status: reported by study-001, not re-verified (code in reserved notebooks)
limitations.detail: Related observation in permitted plot notebooks: noise = numpy.random.normal(0, 0.02, size=nt) is broadcast so the identical noise vector is added to every channel.

seeg_log_power pads win_len=100 zeros at the end; the last 100 samples average over fewer real samples, biasing log power down by up to log(100) ~ 4.6 at the final sample. Window length is fixed in samples (1 s at 100 Hz, 0.8 s at 125 Hz).

compute_slp_sim clamps outliers in place on the caller's array; Stan model log-transforms Obs although compute_slp_sim already returns log power (Obs must be strictly positive or the model yields NaN; caller convention to_verify); i.i.d. Gaussian observation noise ignores autocorrelation; inversion uses 2D Epileptor while data were generated with 6D+m SpatEpiStim (model mismatch); transformed-data wt/wtm computed but unused; prebuilt binaries are Linux-only and CmdStan is not installed locally.
